label: Approval grounding is the command-theory alternative to modal approval failure
note: Exact negation. Mechanism: the assessor's approvals are fixed by the natures, so no nature-fixed profile varies them; with invariance it yields fixed approvals (dctGroundPrice), and under grounding invariance holds exactly when approvals are fixed (Controls). Positive replacement: a command theory whose approvals follow necessarily from a good nature; witnessed non-degenerately in the modified command model (the divine joint model witnesses it only trivially, its single nature-fixed profile being the base). Price: it survives only by denying nature-fixed approval variation, giving up a voluntarist command theory; the model does not decide whether approval or nature is explanatorily prior.
